import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionProducer
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Endomorphism

/-!
# Evaluation of iterated barycentric subdivision

Affine evaluation intertwines barycentric subdivision of vertex chains with
singular subdivision. The same identity holds for every iterate, expressed
using the monoid of categorical endomorphisms.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {m n : ℕ}

/-- Affine evaluation carries vertex-chain subdivision to singular subdivision. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem barycentricSubdivision_affineSingularEvaluation
    (f : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)), X)) (n : ℕ) :
    barycentricSubdivision m n ≫ (affineSingularEvaluation f).f n =
      (affineSingularEvaluation f).f n ≫ singularSubdivision X n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro v
  change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
  rw [vertexListChain_affineSingularEvaluation_assoc, singularSimplexChain_subdivision,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ← affineSingularEvaluation_naturality f v]
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivision n n), barycentricSubdivision_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc, vertexListChain_vertices_map_assoc]

/-- Affine evaluation commutes with every iterate of subdivision. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem barycentricSubdivision_pow_affineSingularEvaluation
    (f : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)), X)) (n k : ℕ) :
    ((End.of (barycentricSubdivision m n)) ^ k) ≫ (affineSingularEvaluation f).f n =
      (affineSingularEvaluation f).f n ≫ ((End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [pow_succ', End.mul_def, Category.assoc]
      rw [barycentricSubdivision_affineSingularEvaluation]
      rw [← Category.assoc, ih, Category.assoc]

/-- Iterated singular subdivision is evaluated iterated affine subdivision
of the standard ordered vertices. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem singularSimplexChain_subdivision_pow
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) (k : ℕ) :
    singularSimplexChain σ ≫ ((End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k) =
      vertexListChain stdSimplex.vertex ≫ ((End.of (barycentricSubdivision n n)) ^ k) ≫
        (affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ)).f n := by
  rw [barycentricSubdivision_pow_affineSingularEvaluation]
  simp only [vertexListChain_vertices_affineSingularEvaluation_assoc,
    Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

end Mumford.Analytic
